title: WPSS/978/2011 of NARAYAN DUTT DEVRARI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND  and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 978/2011
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr. V.B.S. Negi, Senior Advocate with
Mr. Vikas Pandey, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. T.A. Khan, Dy. Advocate General
with Mr. B.P.S. Mer, Brief Holder for the
State.
 Heard learned counsel for the parties
and perused the record.
 Instant petition has been filed by the
petitioner seeking directions to respondents
to promote the petitioner on the post of
Chief Pharmacist from the date, junior to the
petitioner was promoted.
 It is contended by the counsel for the
petitioner that the petitioner is fully eligible
to be promoted as Chief Pharmacist and
there is nothing adverse against the
petitioner for being promoted on the said
post. It is further contended that some
junior persons to the petitioner have been
promoted and the petitioner is also entitled
to be promoted from the date his juniors
were promoted. On this, learned Dy.
Advocate General for the State submits that
at the time of promotion, seniority was
considered, however, if the petitioner has
any grievance, his grievance shall be
considered for which the petitioner should
approach the competent authority.
 Considering the submissions of the
counsel for the parties, the writ petition is
disposed of by permitting the petitioner to
move representation afresh before
respondent no.2 and in case such a
representation is moved within two weeks

from today, the respondent no.2 shall take
decision on the same in accordance with law
within a period of one month from the date
of receipt of representation. In case, it is
found that juniors to the petitioner have
been promoted and there is nothing adverse
against the petitioner, the case of the
petitioner for promotion shall be considered
from the date his juniors have been
promoted.
 Stay application also stands disposed
of.
Let certified copy of this order be
supplied to the counsel for the petitioner,
within 72 hrs., on payment of usual charges.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
 24.09.2013
